prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: personal software engineer portfolio hero photograph, landscape 5:4.
Scene: A believable desk where a small software idea is being worked out. An open unbranded aluminium laptop, an open cream notebook containing a few loose pencil wireframe rectangles and connecting arrows, and one ordinary pencil. No additional decorative props. Workable laptop hinge, trackpad and regular keyboard; screen is softly out of focus and shows only quiet indistinct interface shapes, no legible code or text.
Composition: elevated three-quarter angle, not a flat lay. The laptop is slightly behind the notebook, both form a compact central grouping. Keep their important detail in the middle 70% of the picture so a shallow 16:9 crop can show both; include natural desk margins. The scene feels used for work, with modest asymmetry, not a perfect store display.
Lighting: soft lateral morning window light, gentle realistic shadows, natural restrained colours. Matte desk surface with subtle wood character, aluminium, tactile notebook paper. Photographic lens perspective, editorial interior detail, crisp main objects and gentle falloff toward background.
Quality constraints: real physical construction and plausible proportions, no forced brand palette, no saturated blue or coral props, no artificial paper-grain overlay, no illustration or glossy 3D render. No plants, mugs, random object piles, neon cyber imagery, people, hands, logos, readable typography, labels, captions, watermarks or outer frame.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: personal portfolio interest scene for anime, games and light novels, landscape 16:10.
Scene: A relaxed reading corner at evening, photographed close at an oblique angle. An open paperback light novel resting naturally on a muted soft fabric seat; a single unbranded charcoal game controller beside it. The facing right-hand book page contains an original monochrome ink illustration of a small traveller on a winding path under trees, entirely original with no recognizable franchise. The left page falls softly away from focus and its small text is optically indistinct, not visibly fabricated lettering. The illustrated page must be large and visible enough to serve as an image-editor sample later.
Composition: book fills much of the central-left image, controller rests in the lower-right, both clearly recognizable; tactile curved pages and believable book binding. Not a neat top-down flat lay, no extra pile of props. Warm soft evening light from one side, subdued fabric tones and natural paper whites, moderate depth of field.
Quality constraints: authentic editorial photograph with convincing material, paper edges, page curvature, controller symmetry and buttons; plausible simple controller design with no logos or branded markings. No people or hands. No colour-theme props, no fake grain overlay, no glossy rendering, no illustration-style environment, no fake readable titles, no visible slogans, no watermark, caption, border or outer frame.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: professional personal portfolio portrait, vertical 4:5 photograph.
Input image: the supplied original photograph is the edit target and sole identity reference.
Primary request: Make a restrained professional studio retouch of this exact person's existing photograph. Keep the same person, head position, friendly smile, navy suit jacket and open-collar white shirt. Replace the outdoor glass-and-greenery background with a quiet warm-grey studio backdrop, softly lit without a visible horizon.
Lighting: soft large-window key light with gentle fill, clear natural eye catchlights, flattering but realistic facial modelling. Neutral accurate colour, neither orange nor desaturated.
Framing: head and shoulders, enough room above the hair, full hairline visible, upper chest and both shoulders. Compose for a 4:5 portrait.
Preserve identity exactly: same face proportions, eye shape and spacing, nose, lips, ears, jawline, skin tone, age, haircut and hairline, smile and tooth shapes. Do not reshape face or change expression.
Change only lighting and colour balance, background, very minor temporary blemishes and stray flyaway hairs, subtle fabric cleanup. Keep natural pores, subtle under-eye texture and facial hair. Eyes remain natural dark brown, teeth natural, no beauty-filter smoothing, no waxy skin, no exaggerated sharpening, no glamour makeover. The result should look like a carefully retouched real photograph of the supplied man, not a newly invented lookalike.
No text or watermark.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial photograph for a personal portfolio's gym interest panel.
Primary request: a convincing, beautifully composed photograph of two used iron dumbbells resting on black rubber gym flooring. Portrait 4:5 composition.
Scene and subject: a quiet corner of an ordinary gym, photographed very low to the floor. Two physically plausible matching dumbbells, each with a straight knurled metal handle joining two solid round iron heads. The front dumbbell lies at a gentle diagonal, the second is set a little farther back, with an uncluttered soft-focus background. Keep both dumbbells fully within the frame.
Photography: natural documentary editorial photography, a real camera perspective around a 50 mm lens, careful but unshowy composition. Directional window light from the upper left reveals brushed metal, small scratches and lightly worn edges, while the shaded rubber floor retains detail. Neutral charcoal and silver with a modest warm daylight tint. Sharp front handle and heads, gradual natural depth of field, no exaggerated bokeh.
Materials: tactile rubber floor flecks, honest metallic texture, credible contact shadows and geometry.
Constraints: no people, hands, logos, equipment branding, legible weight numerals, captions, watermark or invented decorative text. No extra props, advertising shine, theatrical smoke, cinematic glow, fake film grain, orange-and-blue grading, pastel palette, illustration, 3D render or excessively perfect showroom staging. This must feel like a restrained high-quality editorial photograph rather than an ad.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial photograph for a personal portfolio's travel planning interest panel.
Primary request: a quiet close detail of an open planning notebook beside a folded anonymous paper map, photographed from a three-quarter overhead angle. Landscape 4:3.
Scene and subject: crop tightly to three things only, the open cream notebook, partially folded map and one graphite pencil, on a plain slightly worn medium-tone oak table. The notebook's right page has a sparse simple pencil route sketch: one winding path connecting four small circles, with two branching dashed alternatives and one rough hill contour. The sketch contains absolutely no letters, numerals or symbols resembling writing. Its left page is blank. The map has fine pale green-grey abstract terrain contours and thin unlabelled roads, with absolutely no text anywhere on it. No identifiable geography. Notebook and map are not aligned perfectly with the camera.
Photography: accomplished natural editorial still-life, real camera optics around 50 mm. Light is soft neutral daylight from an offscreen window. Credible page thickness, binding, creases, perspective and contact shadows. Restrained earthy colours, subtle material detail, moderate depth of field. The route sketch is the focal point, with the map as supporting context. Real paper photography rather than graphic art.
Constraints: no readable or pseudo-readable text, map labels, named destinations, tickets, passport, landmark, person, hands, coffee mug, plant, phone, extra props, captions, logo or watermark. No tourist-ad flat-lay, decorative pile, excessively rustic backdrop, cinematic colour grading, artificial grain, glow, illustration or 3D rendering. The image is an anonymous conceptual planning vignette and implies no specific journey or owned belongings.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial photograph for a personal portfolio's personal finance interest panel.
Primary request: a quiet desk detail with an annotated notebook and a simple calculator, reflecting patient personal planning. Landscape 4:3 composition.
Scene and subject: a small open off-white notebook on a matte warm-grey tabletop, next to one plain unbranded dark basic calculator and a black pen. The page contains sparse pencil planning marks: three small unlabelled columns, horizontal ruled divider lines, a few ticks and circles. No monetary values, holdings, returns, words or percentages. The calculator has a physically plausible ordinary key grid, seen at a natural oblique angle, with its LCD switched off. It feels as though work was paused briefly. Three functional objects only.
Photography: tasteful, high-quality natural editorial photo, a close 50 mm view from slightly above, composed asymmetrically but with the notebook and calculator in the central safe area. Clear material detail and realistic perspective. The notebook is the principal focus, the calculator remains identifiable with a little natural softness.
Lighting and materials: soft late-afternoon daylight from an unseen side window, gentle contact shadows, actual paper fibres and a slightly curved bound page, subtle worn plastic calculator texture. Neutral cream, warm grey and charcoal, accurate colours, no stylised colour treatment.
Constraints: no person or hands; no claimed investments, figures, returns, currency, coins, banknotes, credit cards, charts rising dramatically, branded screens or financial slogans. No fake or garbled writing. No mug, plant, phone or decorative props; no title overlay, caption, logo or watermark. Avoid conspicuous stock-photo staging, glossy showroom shine, extreme bokeh, artificial grain, cinematic blue/orange lighting, illustration, 3D render or synthetic texture. This is a conceptual interest photograph and does not document anyone's actual financial information.

Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent website mascot sticker.
Primary request: Remove ONLY the uniform grey background from the provided waving explorer mascot gripping a rope. Preserve the existing character, pose, face, skin tone, goggles, cloak, satchel, boots, rope, heavy ink lines and thick white die-cut keyline exactly. Do not redraw or restyle. Preserve the entire character and rope as supplied; no additional environment. Return a genuinely transparent alpha background, including background gaps around the arms and rope.
